notes: Audit #2 Batch 5 «UI/UX و محصول» (v1.11.72) — the fifth and LAST of the 5 approved batches of the v1.11.67 full audit (88/100, 0 Critical, 0 High); all 5 batches are now built. (1) L30 — the assignments debounced search handler now re-renders the filter bar alongside the list, so the «پاک کردن فیلتر» button appears after a search-only filter (typing «اسید» narrowed the list to 4 cards but the button stayed null — the bar only re-rendered from the tab render). The 250 ms debounce stays; re-rendering replaces the input element, so focus + caret are restored when the user was still typing in it. (2) L31 — the data-completeness meter (ب-۸) counts only STORED test totals as entered: on seed data it now shows boxesEntered 0/181 instead of 15/181 — those 15 came from titles with an explicit number (e.g. «۳۰ تست»), not from user-entered data. allBoxes() now carries tests_total_stored (state value, else the seed field, never the title inference) and the meter reports the inferred ones apart as «+۱۵ از روی عنوان». The topics side and the Analytics one-liner are unchanged; every display that shows a box's total still uses the effective (possibly inferred) total — only the meter's «entered» definition changed. (3) C7 — collapsed exam-budget chapter summaries now carry the topic count («حسابان ۲ · ۱ مبحث», new exTopics key), so the budget can be scanned without opening each chapter. (4) R2 — the «next box» highlight (خ-۲) now persists across re-renders until the next tick / tab change: PENDING_NEXT_FOCUS is no longer consumed at the end of the first renderToday — opening the just-ticked card keeps the highlight on the next undone box. The guarded auto-scroll still fires only once per tick (scrolled flag); a tab change drops the pointer (cleared in applyRoute, the choke point for navigate + Back/hashchange). (5) L17 — checkSleepReminder has the same hidden-tab guard L-PERF5 added to checkNextBoxReminder (if (document.hidden) return;) — a reminder the user never saw is no longer marked as seen (sleepReminded[TODAY] stays unset while hidden, so the one-shot «گوشی رو بذار کنار» is not consumed unseen; it fires once when the tab is visible inside the 30-minute window). (6) L28 — the contradiction lint now catches within-rule duplicates: the old code collapsed each rule into a dict first, so the `.link-editor` align-items:center/align-items:stretch pair passed; the lint is now a shared helper (_find_css_contradictions) flagging a property repeated with DIFFERENT values in one rule, and the dead `align-items: center` is removed (effective value stays `stretch`). A property repeated with the SAME value is still not a contradiction (documented Batch 7 deviation). (7) L29 — light --border-strong darkened further, #aab4c0 -> #93a1b1 (1.85:1 -> 2.32:1 vs the page, WCAG 2.1, same helper as the Batch 7 test) — the AA-safe lever, since the token is never used as a text colour. The sidebar background is NOT darkened (Batch 7 proved that breaks the muted-on-sidebar pair at 4.45:1); the muted-on-sidebar pair stays 4.76:1 and all borderline pairs pinned by test_mui5_borderline_contrast_intact stay intact. Nothing deferred. i18n 1441/1441 (2 new keys: exTopics, tbDataMeterInferred, both languages). All 5 audit #2 batches complete: 1.11.68 (M1+M2+L1+L6+L20), 1.11.69 (M4+C4+L18+L16), 1.11.70 (M3+L26+L32+L22), 1.11.71 (L13+L14+L8/L9+L10+L15), 1.11.72 (L30+L31+C7+R2+L17+L28+L29).
